name: APWA National Championship
caption: Pipe Bomb was crowned the first APWA-and-EAPW National Heavyweight Champion at APOW's debut; J.D. "The Bird" Raven won a National Championship tournament match at Tourney Smash a month later -- the title's own path between the two is not recovered in the held record.
epitaph: APWA National Championship of APWA: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.

name: APWA Championship
caption: Won by Taylor "The Godfather" Luchinni in the Tourney Smash ladder-match main event, the held record's first attested APWA Championship (World Heavyweight) reign.
epitaph: APWA Championship of APWA: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.
